subject: Offer: Senior Platform Engineer — start date, clauses & redlines
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft offer for Alex J — please review redlines and start date options

Hi team,

Attached is my first pass at the offer for Alex Johnson (Senior Platform Engineer). Key points to confirm:
- Base salary: $210,000
- Target OTE (bonus): 10% annual
- Equity: 0.35% (4-year schedule, 1-year cliff) — legal asked to confirm cliff language
- Sign-on bonus: $25,000, payable within 30 days of start (we should confirm payroll timing)
- Relocation reimbursement: up to $8,000 (receipts required)

Questions for you:
1) Start date windows: Lauren suggested Mar 24, I proposed Mar 31 to give time for onboarding scheduling. Any blocker to offering Apr 7 if candidate requests later?
2) Probation/notice wording — current draft references a 90-day performance review; Lauren, please advise if we want a fixed probation clause or informal language.
3) Any other compliance redlines (NDAs, IP assignment, background checks)?

I've attached offer_draft_v1.docx with inline comments. Can you each reply with redlines by EOD today so I can send to Alex tomorrow morning?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft offer for Alex J — please review redlines and start date options

Thanks Hannah — reviewed and left inline redlines (attached). Highlights:
- Move the vesting schedule language into plain English; replace legalese: "4 years with a 1 year cliff, monthly thereafter" is fine.
- Replace "probation" with "initial performance review at 90 days" to avoid implied termination conditions.
- For sign-on payment timing: request net 45 days to ensure payroll run catches it (we can make it "within 45 days" instead of 30).
- Candidate asked about equity acceleration on change of control in intro call — I added optional language (lightweight) but would like Markus/legal to confirm standard wording.
- Approve relocation reimbursement but limit to receipts within first 90 days.

Start date: candidate verbally said late March; if candidate requests early April we should be flexible. Recommend offering Mar 31 as default and say we can accommodate Apr 7 if needed.

I'll keep Priya on standby for comp approval, but this looks fine from hiring perspective.

-Lauren
Director, Engineering Recruiting

Alex — great speaking yesterday. Attached is the formal offer letter (v2) reflecting the updates from recruiting and compensation:
- Base: $210,000
- Sign-on: $25,000 (now phrased to be paid within 45 days of start)
- Equity: 0.35% over 4 years, 1-year cliff, monthly thereafter
- Relocation: up to $8,000 with receipts; reimbursement paid in first 90 days
- Initial performance review at 90 days (informational)

We put a tentative start date of March 31 in the letter. If you need to move to April 7 due to notice period, that is fine — please indicate your preferred start date when you sign.

Please review the attached PDF and sign via DocuSign (link below) if everything looks good. If you have any clause questions (vesting cliff, sign-on timing, IP assignment), reply here and we will clarify.

Hi Hannah / Lauren — thanks for the offer and quick turnaround. A few questions before I sign:
1) Start date: I need to provide a two-week notice to my current employer and have one set of relocation logistics; would April 7 work instead of March 31?
2) Vesting cliff: can you confirm that the 1-year cliff means no vesting until 12 months have elapsed, then monthly thereafter? Just want to be sure there isn't a separate "clawback" provision.
3) Sign-on: is the $25k paid as a lump sum, and will it be grossed up or subject to repayment if I leave within 12 months?

Everything else looks great — excited about the role. I can sign as soon as these clarifications are added to the letter.

Best,
Alex

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Platform Engineer — Formal Offer (v2)

Hi Alex — great questions, and happy to confirm: 
1) Start date: April 7 works fine. We've updated the DocuSign envelope to reflect that as an optional start date — you can choose the preferred date when you sign.
2) Vesting: correct — 1-year cliff means no options vest until the 12-month anniversary, then vesting occurs monthly thereafter to complete the 4-year schedule. No additional clawback beyond standard repayment of sign-on if you leave within the specified repayment window. We added a sentence clarifying that sign-on bonus is repayable on a prorated basis if departure occurs within 12 months.
3) Sign-on timing: the $25,000 will be paid as a lump sum on the first payroll cycle after your start date (we've set payroll timing expectation to within 45 days). It is subject to standard tax withholdings.

Next steps: Please follow the DocuSign link and select April 7 as your start date if that fits. If you'd prefer March 31, select that instead. Let me know if you want any of the clarified clauses included verbatim in the PDF before signing — we can re-issue a final signed copy.

Welcome aboard — excited to have you join us.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Engineering Recruiting
